source.title: Glossary
source.description: Terminology reference defining core concepts including the agentic loop, `CLAUDE.md`, compaction, hooks, skills, subagents versus agent teams, MCP, permission modes, sessions, and checkpoints, each linking to its in-depth page.

source.title: Best practices for Claude Code
source.description: Context window as the core constraint — verification checks Claude can run, plan mode before coding, lean `CLAUDE.md`, `/clear` and subagents, parallel sessions and headless `-p` fan-out, common failure patterns.

source.title: Tools reference
source.description: Catalogue of built-in tools with exact names used in permission rules, subagent lists, and hook matchers; the `ToolName(specifier)` rule format; and per-tool behaviour for `Bash`, `Read`, `Edit`, `Grep`, and `WebFetch`.

source.title: Configure permissions
source.description: `allow`/`ask`/`deny` rules with deny-first precedence, permission modes (`acceptEdits`, `plan`, `bypassPermissions`), per-tool specifier syntax for `Bash`/`WebFetch`/`MCP`/`Agent`, gitignore-style `Read`/`Edit` path anchors, `PreToolUse` hooks, managed settings, and workspace trust.

source.title: Extend Claude with skills
source.description: `SKILL.md` frontmatter for authoring skills, invocation control (`disable-model-invocation`/`user-invocable`), location precedence across personal/project/plugin, `$ARGUMENTS` and `!command` injection, `context: fork` subagents, and evaluation with `skill-creator`.

source.title: Create custom subagents
source.description: Defining specialized delegates in `.claude/agents/` with YAML frontmatter (`tools`, `model`, `permissionMode`, `skills`, `memory`, `hooks`); scope precedence, built-in Explore/Plan agents, automatic versus `@`-mention/`--agent` delegation, and `/fork` inheriting the conversation.

source.title: Create plugins
source.description: When to package `.claude/` config as a namespaced plugin — the `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` manifest, root-level `skills/`, `agents/`, `hooks/`, `.mcp.json`, `.lsp.json`, `monitors/`, `--plugin-dir` testing, migration, and marketplace submission.

source.title: Plugins reference
source.description: Full schemas for `plugin.json` and every component — hook events, MCP and LSP servers, monitors — plus `claude plugin` CLI commands, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` substitutions, the update-surviving `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}` directory, caching, and versioning.

source.title: Run Claude Code programmatically
source.description: Non-interactive `claude -p` for CI and scripts: `--bare` skips hooks/plugins/MCP auto-discovery, `--output-format json` with `--json-schema` structures results, `--allowedTools`/permission-modes auto-approve, stdin piping, and `--continue`/`--resume` for multi-turn sessions.
